description: The Brown Faux Marble Rectangular TV Table Set has a distinctive look with its sturdy wood construction and faux brown marble top. This set includes foldable TV trays and one storage stand. The handle on the top of the stand makes it easy to transport the entire set from one room to another. A true home furnishings staple.
